creator: Alexander Terp
description: MIP-4 Delivery stage 5. `msg.peer`, peer links over the forwarded socket (Decision 4 (a): the app holds the link), replicas, presence over the link, forwarding to the home, and loud failure when the link is down, in the `--ssh` tier. Proves: a laptop agent and a devenv agent in plain terminals share one group, the guard holds across the link, and local groups keep working while it is cut.
title: MIP-4 stage 5: messages across machines
